title: Odisha Gopabandhu Jana Arogya Yojana (GJAY) Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Odisha government health assurance programme providing cashless treatment to eligible residents through government and empanelled facilities.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility follows Odisha's current beneficiary and household/category rules.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Odisha Gopabandhu Jana Arogya Yojana (GJAY).

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
